Results.ReviewText: Great performance for a small grill (though can grill more than you think on the surface).  I hesitated placing a grill on a rather small landing on the stairs leading to our deck.  After uninstalling one shelf (easy, not needed) this little beauty tucks into a corner perfectly.  I measure the upper part by the railings 27 1/2" wide and 22" deep.  If you can visualize a corner then draw a straight line at 45 degrees to a post 50" away.  Without one shelf that left 18" to pass by the post and corner of the grill.  Simple to put together and accurate thermometer.  The Weber app is very complete and easy to use.  Perfect.
Results.Title: Perfect Little Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are very sorry to hear that you have experienced leaking with three separate hoses. That is definitely not normal! Our hose and regulator assemblies are checked for quality before being shipped, so it is unlikely that you would receive 3 faulty hoses in a row. In these instances, we recommend trying a different gas tank as the leak may be originating at the tank. 
Our support team is reaching out to provide further assistance and to make sure that your grill is working again. Thanks for your patience and for being a Weber fan!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Very frustrated I own two weber grills one of which is 20 years old and never had a problem bought this new Weber Grill in Charleston South Carolina for home and the wheel on the back of it immediately broke off. I knew the model had a problem when I went online to order wheel and found out they were out of stock. Weber sent me wheels but I found out that the bolts that hold them on were so tight they could not be removed so now I have a brick underneath my new weber grill so it doesn’t list. Would not buy this model again.None of the wheels on the bottom of this grill look like they will last too long if the grill is moved

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
